sentences.text: 1. This application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed in connection with Kegaon P.S. Case No.167 of 2023 corresponding to Criminal Trial No.139 of 2023 (Sessions), pending in the file of the learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Dharamgarh under Section 376 (3) (2) (L) of IPC and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.

2. Mr. M.K.Panda, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as trial has started, the petitioner wants to withdraw this bail application in order to move the learned Court below after examination of the victim girl.
3. Considering the said submission, the BLAPL is dismissed granting liberty to the petitioner to move the learned Court below for bail afresh after examination of the victim girl and her parents.
4. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.

..............................
 Bichi (SAVITRI RATHO)
